prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished high-fidelity DESKTOP 404 error page design proposal for the Korean study web app "공부의 숲". Landscape 1536x1024. Cohesive delicate hand-painted watercolor forest visual theme, warm ivory paper background, sage and olive leaves, pale butter-yellow daisies, soft pigment blooms. Large open ivory top and central area, watercolor trees and soft meadow foliage along extreme left/right edges and bottom, no heavy canopy overlapping the header. At top left show the small dark olive handmade Korean wordmark exact "공부의 숲" with two sprout leaves on its last character. Main composition centered, airy and calm. Large "404" in rounded dark sage typography, subtle watercolor pigment texture, about 140 pixels high, readable, not a giant character collage. Beneath it a small cohesive watercolor scene: the round pale yellow-green sprout mascot (tiny dark oval eyes, peach cheeks, smile, moss green feet, two olive sprout leaves on its head) sitting beside an open cream book on a low mossy meadow; a simple small wooden forest signpost points to a gentle curving path fading into light paper. The mascot appears mildly curious and reassuring, not sad or distressed. Ground the illustration with grasses and a few daisies, softly feathered edges, about 300 pixels wide and 200 pixels tall. Place the scene ABOVE the error heading and buttons, never behind text. Main heading exact "숲길을 잠시 벗어났어요" in charcoal Korean sans-serif, bold, about 32px. Supporting line exact "찾으시는 페이지가 없거나 주소가 변경되었어요." in muted warm gray, about 18px. Below, two navigation buttons side by side: primary a rounded wide olive watercolor filled pill with white bold text exact "스터디 목록으로"; secondary a smaller ivory pill with thin sage border and dark sage text exact "이전 페이지". Small arrow icon optional inside primary. Buttons have clean rounded capsule silhouette, background fills entire button, subtle soft shadow. Plenty of breathing room between 404, illustration, heading, description and controls; all content fits comfortably in a desktop viewport. Small quiet footer with a tiny sprout and "공부의 숲". Fresh gentle professional readable UI, matches a study tracker, no sidebar, no study cards, no top menu links, no extra characters, no browser chrome, no decorative headings outside the page, no watermarks. This is an actual finished page mockup, not a concept board, not wireframe.
purpose: 404 페이지 디자인 시안. 앱 소스 변경 없음.
verification: 생성 이미지 육안 검토. 실제 화면 구현·브라우저 검증 아님.
